# Command Cookbook

## Purpose

Provide copy-ready command sequences for the full solution lifecycle.

## 1) Full staged run (strict profile example)

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
PROJECT="/work/prostate-cancer/configs/project_Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG.json"

methyl-validation --project "$PROJECT" --stability
methyl-validation --project "$PROJECT" --freeze
methyl-validation --project "$PROJECT" --model
methyl-validation --project "$PROJECT" --post-model-validation
```

## 2) Backend comparison and selection

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
PROJECT="/work/prostate-cancer/configs/project_Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG.json"

methyl-validation --project "$PROJECT" --model-mc --model-mc-all
methyl-validation --project "$PROJECT" --select-best-model --model-mc-all \
  --selection-metric balanced_accuracy --selection-stat median
```

## 3) Rollout comparison report

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
PROJECT="/work/prostate-cancer/configs/project_Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG.json"
BASE="/work/prostate-cancer/Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG/monte_carlo_runs/model_mc/ecdf/metrics_summary.json"
CAND="/work/prostate-cancer/Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG/monte_carlo_runs/model_mc/tabular_sklearn/metrics_summary.json"

methyl-validation --project "$PROJECT" --rollout-compare \
  --baseline-summary "$BASE" --candidate-summary "$CAND"
```

## 4) Standalone enricher run from mapper output

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
methyl-enricher \
  --input /work/prostate-cancer/Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG/mapper/all/pca_pca1/all-gene_name-combined.csv \
  --modules \
  --library-preset cancer-extended \
  --outdir /work/prostate-cancer/Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG/enricher/all/pca_pca1
```

## 5) Standalone blind prediction

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
methyl-predictor --project /work/prostate-cancer/Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG/monte_carlo_runs/production/project.json
```

## 6) Manual rendering commands (this manual)

```bash
quarto render docs/user-manual --to html
quarto render docs/user-manual --to pdf
```

## 7) Distributed queue (one task)

Full workflow: [Distributed MethylValidation on shared storage](12-distributed-methyl-validation.qmd) (`12`). One worker invocation:

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
methyl-validation run-task --task /work/.../monte_carlo_runs/queue/tasks/run_0001.json
```

## 8) Hyperparameter search grid (example)

After `plan-runs` / full stability is understood, use the grid driver. Details: [Optional hyperparameter search](13-optional-hyperparameter-search.qmd) (`13`).

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
methyl-hyperparam-search \
  --config /work/experiments/my_mc_config.json \
  --work-dir /work/experiments/hp_run1 \
  --grid '{"stability_dmp_freq": [0.6, 0.7]}' \
  -- --stability
```

## Execution notes

- Always activate `.venv` before `methyl-*` commands.
- Use absolute project paths in production scripts.
- Keep command logs with timestamp and git commit hash for audit.
